core_obligations: Sheaf property: glue the morphisms f_i to f and the algebra maps varphi_i to varphi over the covering.
Chart representability: F_i is identified with the base-changed functor over the affine U_i via the base-change lemma, represented by the affine case.
F_i is contained in F representably by open immersions: a pullback lands in the chart iff its image lies in the preimage of U_i.
The charts cover F since the U_i cover S.
proof_roadmap: Glue the pair data over overlaps, identify charts with the affine functor via base change, verify the last two steps definitionally.
difficulty_reason: Four-step glue-functors verification mirroring the Proj case; fully displayed.
